uplink.description: Status report: 3.6 V, input0 5.1 mA, input1 10.3 mA
uplink._note: TTN example status report (netvox r718ka2 codec yaml, Apache-2.0). Upstream oracle: Volt 3.6, Current_1 5, Current_2 10, FineCurrent_1 0.1, FineCurrent_2 0.3. byte3 0x24 -> 3.6 V; interleaved layout: byte4=5 + byte6=1 (0.1) -> input0 analog.current 5.1 mA; byte5=10 + byte7=3 (0.1) -> input1 analog.current 10.3 mA. Each input loop's reading is a channels[] entry; battery stays top-level. Satisfies analog-interface.

uplink.description: Both loops across the 4-20 mA span: 3.6 V, input0 4.2 mA, input1 19.7 mA
uplink._note: Synthetic two-loop frame in the TTN status-report shape (device id 0x44), pinning the interleaved byte order: the per-channel integer mA sit side by side in bytes[4]/bytes[5] and the 0.1 mA parts in bytes[6]/bytes[7], so each entry reads a straddling pair. Upstream oracle semantics: Current_1=4 + FineCurrent_1=0.2 -> input0 4.2 mA (loop low end); Current_2=19 + FineCurrent_2=0.7 -> input1 19.7 mA (loop high end). Values are far apart so a transposed pair would fail.
